rationale: PostgreSQL FTS + pg_trgm is sufficient for V1 tool search
Deterministic policy engine only — LLMs are non-deterministic and must not gate security decisions

decision: No vector search until lexical/metadata search proves inadequate

rationale: NATS JetStream for all async — polling Postgres creates lock contention at scale
Ephemeral only — rate limit and session cache always fail open (SI-14)

decision: buildApp() takes deps: { db: DbPool } for testability
rationale: Allows mock DB injection in E2E and load tests without real Postgres

decision: Policy engine fails closed on DB error (DENY)
rationale: Never fail-open past policy — a DB error must not silently allow execution (SI-04)

decision: API key auth uses X-Api-Key header, NOT Authorization: Bearer
rationale: Bearer is reserved for JWT session tokens. requireAuth() routes X-Api-Key to validateApiKey(), Bearer to verifySessionToken()

decision: API key prefix extraction: rawKey.slice(0, rawKey.lastIndexOf('_') + 9)
rationale: Key format is arc_live_<64hex>. Last underscore + 9 chars = arc_live_ + 8 hex chars = the stored prefix

decision: Load tests use RATE_LIMIT_PER_KEY_RPM=10000 in testConfig
rationale: Prevents accidental self-throttling during load rounds. Rate-limit test pre-seeds the counter via _seedCounter helper instead
Keeps exhausted counter isolated from main test key so mixed-workload test is not affected

decision: vi.mock factories must use only inline literals
rationale: Vitest hoists vi.mock factories before const declarations — any module-level variable reference inside throws 'Cannot access X before initialization'

decision: Python SDK uses plain dataclasses with from_dict(), no Pydantic

rationale: API response shape is { data: [], next_cursor, total } — the field is 'data'
Consistent with the class definition in packages/auth/src/errors.ts

decision: All deviations from master architecture require an ADR in docs/decisions/
rationale: Maintains architectural integrity and decision traceability
